method: Pinned JS release builds. Deep library samples time 16 full searches each, with four process pairs and nine retained samples per process. Ordinary library samples time 500 calls, with three process pairs and nine retained samples each. CLI results include startup, I/O and peak RSS with nine retained pairs. Reversing arguments switches the initial order. Same-binary controls call 0.2.27 twice. The recorded trials were rebuilt in separate target directories and checked by hash after an exploratory incremental build returned a stale artifact.

probes.method: The baseline counts calls, copied element references and timer values for each array copy. The candidate checks that the append function has no copy and counts append and pop operations on the working path. The process totals include warmups and each fixture's budget checks. Probe timer totals include timer and counter overhead.
